card.name: Pointing to a table or chart
card.fires_on: The word "the" or "Table" right after a cross-reference such as "see", "shown on" or "found in", where the next word is a table, chart, step list or other labeled item.

modes.label: "the" after see/shown in
modes.description: The word "the" after a pointer phrase, just before a named chart, steps or object.

modes.label: "Table" in a reference
modes.description: The word "Table" in a parenthetical pointer just before its number.

card.writes: It lowers the chance of list or section words next and slightly favors other continuations.
